tags.note: Mobotix M16 camera. May be optioned with LPR sensors, however this camera is likely mounted too high to be used as a ALPR. Possibly used to monitor traffic count or road temperature/conditions.

The camera was rotated to face northbound traffic since this was first surveyed, according to Mapillary imagery. The licensee is likely New Canaan since it matches the placement of their other cameras at town boundaries.
This camera was added to the street lamp following incidents with a CT state police sergeant and Youtube streamers. See source.
